newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures slip in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures slip in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures slipped across the board on Wednesday as the view that prices were too high after gains during the day helped local investors take profits, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.4 yen to 0.8 yen per kg lower from the day's close. Benchmark June was off 0.8 at 147.5 yen. Volume was 5,976 lots.

During the day, the yen's weaker tendency lifted prices slightly. "The only incentive in the market was the currency market as overseas markets were closed for Christmas holidays," one trader said. -- Tokyo Commodity Desk +81-3-3432-7431
